J-K BJP Leader's Missing Son Found in Delhi

Aditya Sharma, the son of J-K BJP MLA Vijay Sharma from the Hiranagar Assembly constituency, who had gone missing, has been located in New Delhi. Officials stated he is being brought back. He was reported missing in Kathua, J&K.
